# `esp32c6` control (`ctl`): every run

A run is one flash of the control image `c6-ctl.bin`. Each run's value is the median over that boot's complete rounds of the firmware's printed median; the median of the runs is published in `esp32c6.json` and RESULTS.md. Spread is (slowest − fastest run) / median.
